# Federation API

9 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation`

Get a repository's federation status

Federation health of one repository: whether it is enabled, the log position, and every peer (with its state, lag and backlog) and inbound token. Requires the repository-scoped manage permission (global administrators have it) or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project. `supported` is false for proxy and group repositories and for formats without federation.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Federation status | `application/json`: [FederationStatus](schemas.md#federationstatus) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation`

Enable or disable federation

Enabling backfills the change log from the repository's existing content. Disabling removes the log and all peers. Idempotent. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [UpdateFederationRequest](schemas.md#updatefederationrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The new federation status | `application/json`: [FederationStatus](schemas.md#federationstatus) |
| `400` | Invalid request, or the repository is not hosted or its format has no federation (error code validation_failed) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/peers`

Add a federation peer

Registers a remote instance to pull this repository's changes from. The base URL is validated against the outbound (SSRF) policy. Requires federation to be enabled (409 otherwise) and the repository-scoped manage permission.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [CreateFederationPeerRequest](schemas.md#createfederationpeerrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Peer added | `application/json`: [FederationPeer](schemas.md#federationpeer) |
| `400` | Invalid request (error code validation_failed) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `409` | Federation is not enabled, or a peer with this name already exists | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PATCH /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/peers/{id}`

Update a federation peer

Changes a peer's name, URL, credentials or enabled flag; absent fields stay unchanged. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Peer id. |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [UpdateFederationPeerRequest](schemas.md#updatefederationpeerrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The updated peer | `application/json`: [FederationPeer](schemas.md#federationpeer) |
| `400` | Invalid request (error code validation_failed) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository or peer not found | - |
| `409` | A peer with this name already exists | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/peers/{id}`

Delete a federation peer

Stops pulling from the peer and forgets its cursor and deferred units. Content already applied stays. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Peer id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Peer deleted | - |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository or peer not found | - |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/peers/{id}/deferred`

List a peer's deferred units

Units pulled from the peer that could not be applied yet (for example a dependency has not arrived) and are being retried. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Peer id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The deferred units | `application/json`: [FederationDeferredList](schemas.md#federationdeferredlist) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository or peer not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/peers/{id}/resync`

Resync a federation peer

Resets the peer's cursor so the next pass re-reads its whole log and merges it idempotently. Returns at once; the peer reports resync_requested until the pass starts. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Peer id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Resync queued | `application/json`: [FederationPeer](schemas.md#federationpeer) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository or peer not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/tokens`

Create an inbound federation token

Mints a token a peer presents to pull this repository's log. The clear-text token is returned only in this response. Requires federation to be enabled (409 otherwise) and the repository-scoped manage permission.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [CreateFederationTokenRequest](schemas.md#createfederationtokenrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Token created | `application/json`: [FederationTokenCreated](schemas.md#federationtokencreated) |
| `400` | Invalid request (error code validation_failed) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `409` | Federation is not enabled | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/federation/tokens/{id}`

Revoke an inbound federation token

The token stops working at once; it stays listed with revoked_at set. Same permission as the status read.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Token id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Token revoked | - |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository or token not found | - |
